_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Required Navigation Performance (RNP) Compliance Analysis
summary: Provides an analysis of system performance accuracy, containment integrity, containment continuity, and containment compliance evaluation in accordance with RTCA DO-236C.
use_relationship:
The Required Navigation Performance (RNP) Compliance Analysis provides an analysis of system performance accuracy, containment integrity, containment continuity, and containment compliance evaluation in accordance with RTCA DO-236C, Sections 4.1.2, 4.2, 4.3, and 4.4.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract statement of work (SOW).

This analysis will be used to show compliance to the system performance requirements contained in the NAVAIR System Specification for Performance-Based Navigation
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions shall be as specified in the contract.  The documents cited below establish the baseline for this DID's content.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The RNP Compliance Analysis shall be in contractor's format, unless the RNP system includes the Government Furnished Information (GFI) Flight Management Function (FMF) Application, then the format shall be government supplied.
